headline: Florida loggerhead release puts a satellite-tracked turtle back at sea
summary: The Sea Turtle Conservancy scheduled an August 2 release from Florida's Archie Carr Refuge as part of Tour de Turtles conservation and tracking.
script: A rehabilitated loggerhead is returning to Florida's Atlantic with a satellite transmitter. The Sea Turtle Conservancy will track its route through the Tour de Turtles program, turning one release into public science. That data can show where ocean wildlife needs protection.
